text:
Alex (CEO): Appreciated the turnout today. Quick follow-up thread for strategy Qs — keep them short.
Jordan (Growth): We need a crisp elevator pitch for customer calls that mentions portability + cost.
Maya (Head of Product): How about: "Redwood makes inference predictable and economical across hosted, dedicated, and private runs." under 12 words.
Sam (VP Eng): Customers ask whether Dedicated reduces latency for interactive workloads; what's the safe claim?
Ravi (CTO): Claim: "Dedicated offers reserved GPU capacity and optimized routing for lower p95 latency vs shared hosted tiers." Add that results depend on model and config.
Priya (Solutions): For compliance customers: is Private equivalent feature-wise to Dedicated except for control plane placement?
Maya (Head of Product): Yes — same API and feature set; Private adds VPC, KMS/HSM, and audit log integrations. SEs can cite the compliance checklist.
Jordan (Growth): Competitive positioning: should we name competitors or keep it generic on calls?
Alex (CEO): Prefer generic in top-funnel. In deeper conversations, we can map feature-by-feature against specific vendors; keep public messaging constructive.
Sam (VP Eng): Roadmap ask: what's prioritized this quarter — observability, quantization, or routing?
Maya (Head of Product): Order of priority: 1) token-level cost observability (console widgets), 2) model-variant routing (fallbacks), 3) quantized kernel rollout. All three in the next two releases.
Ravi (CTO): Note: quantized kernel work requires regression testing across our model catalog; expect staged rollouts.
Priya (Solutions): Can we reassure customers about migrations from Hosted -> Dedicated? Need exact phrasing.
Jordan (Growth): Proposed line: "Prototype on Hosted, then lift & shift to Dedicated with config export, model pinning, and SE migration support."
Alex (CEO): Good. One more: internal teams — which metric should everyone track next quarter?
Maya (Head of Product): Two metrics: TTFSQ (time-to-first-successful-query) and cost per 1M tokens for top 20 customers.
DevRel Bot: Reminder: product one-pager draft in #docs for review; deadline EOD Friday.
Alex (CEO): Thanks — if unanswered follow-ups, tag the relevant owner and we'll respond in their channels.
